extras: If cloning this repo, the folder in .obsidian/plugins must be named zhongwen-reader, not obsidian-zhongwen-reader.
intentEvidence: Zhongwen Reader is a lightweight hover dictionary plugin for Obsidian that makes it easy to read Chinese text and build your vocabulary, all from within your notes.
problem: Reading Chinese text within Obsidian is difficult without external dictionary tools, and building a vocabulary from notes is not natively supported.

relations.evidence: Export saved vocab as markdown flashcards for the Spaced Repetition plugin.

summary: Zhongwen Reader is a lightweight hover dictionary plugin that allows users to instantly view definitions, save vocabulary, and export flashcards for Chinese text within Obsidian.
